SEA_GLASS.YUWANCARD-PIG.title: Sea Glass
YUWANCARD-SEVEN_CURSES_SELECT.title: Ring of Seven Curses
YUWANCARD-SEVEN_CURSES_SELECT.descriptio: Obtain the Ring of Seven Curses relic
YUWANCARD-SEVEN_CURSES_SKIP.title: Skip
YUWANCARD-SEVEN_CURSES_SKIP.description: Do not select the Ring of Seven Curses, continue.
YUWANCARD-RING_OF_SEVEN_CURSES.title: Ring of Seven Curses
YUWANCARD-RING_OF_SEVEN_CURSES.descripti: Damage taken +50%, damage to non-Boss enemies -25%, [gold]Block[/gold] gained -20%, Gold gained -50%, [gold]Rest Site[/gold] HP recovery -25%, gain a [gold]Curse card[/gold] at the start of each turn, max HP -25% after killing a Boss. {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}+1, Draw +1, [gold]Rest Site[/gold] card upgrade +1, [gold]Card rewards[/gold] +1, damage to Bosses +50%, normal enemies have a chance to drop [gold]Relics[/gold], can ignore path when selecting rooms on each floor.
YUWANCARD-RING_OF_SEVEN_CURSES.additiona: [gold][Ring of Seven Curses][/gold] heal [red]15% of max HP ({ActualHeal})[/red].
YUWANCARD-TEN_YEAR_BAMBOO.title: Ten Year Bamboo
YUWANCARD-TEN_YEAR_BAMBOO.description: Gain {BlockBonus} [gold]Block[/gold] at the start of each turn. Defeating Elite enemies increases Block by 1. Defeating Bosses increases Block by 3.
YUWANCARD-TEN_YEAR_BAMBOO.flavor: Ten years of bamboo, tough and resilient.
YUWANCARD-HAOTIAN_HAMMER.title: Haotian Hammer
YUWANCARD-HAOTIAN_HAMMER.description: Whenever a [gold]Sovereign Blade[/gold] is added to any player's hand, upgrade it.
YUWANCARD-REINCARNATED_EYE.title: Reincarnated Eye
YUWANCARD-REINCARNATED_EYE.description: At the start of each combat, choose a card from your [gold]draw pile[/gold] to copy and add to your hand.
YUWANCARD-REINCARNATED_EYE.flavor: Twin pupils are already the road to invincibility; why borrow another's bones?
YUWANCARD-REINCARNATED_EYE.selectionProm: Choose a card from your deck to copy
YUWANCARD-SUPREME_BONE.title: Supreme Bone
YUWANCARD-SUPREME_BONE.description: At the start of each combat, choose 2 cards from your deck and give them [gold]Exhaust[/gold]. When your HP first drops below [blue]30%[/blue], gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}, draw [blue]3[/blue] cards.
YUWANCARD-SUPREME_BONE.flavor: Who claims to be invincible? Who dares speak of never losing?
YUWANCARD-SUPREME_BONE.selectionPrompt: Choose 2 cards from your deck to give [gold]Exhaust[/gold]
YUWANCARD-ARROGANT_PIG.title: Arrogant Pig
YUWANCARD-ARROGANT_PIG.description: Take [blue]2[/blue] additional damage when attacked. Deal [blue]50%[/blue] more damage to [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] enemies. Take [blue]30%[/blue] less damage from [gold]Weak[/gold] enemies.
YUWANCARD-ARROGANT_PIG.flavor: The arrogant pig always pays the price.
YUWANCARD-JEALOUS_PIG.title: Jealous Pig
YUWANCARD-JEALOUS_PIG.description: In each combat, when an enemy first gains a Buff power, you also gain the same power. Draw 1 additional card each turn.
YUWANCARD-JEALOUS_PIG.flavor: The jealous pig wants everything others have.
YUWANCARD-FURIOUS_PIG.title: Furious Pig
YUWANCARD-FURIOUS_PIG.description: At the start of each combat, gain {StrengthPower} [gold]Strength[/gold] and 1 [gold]Frail[/gold].
YUWANCARD-FURIOUS_PIG.flavor: The furious pig has boundless strength.
YUWANCARD-LAZY_PIG.title: Lazy Pig
YUWANCARD-LAZY_PIG.description: Every 2 turns, gain 2 [gold]Dexterity[/gold]. 50% less chance to draw [gold]Attack cards[/gold].
YUWANCARD-LAZY_PIG.flavor: The lazy pig prefers not to move.
YUWANCARD-GREEDY_PIG.title: Greedy Pig
YUWANCARD-GREEDY_PIG.description: At the start of each combat, add a [gold]Greed[/gold] to your hand. [gold]Gold[/gold] gained +100%.
YUWANCARD-GREEDY_PIG.flavor: The greedy pig always wants more.
YUWANCARD-GLUTTONOUS_PIG.title: Gluttonous Pig
YUWANCARD-GLUTTONOUS_PIG.description: You can eat your [gold]card rewards[/gold]. For every [blue]2[/blue] cards eaten, at the start of each combat gain 1 [gold]Plating[/gold] and 1 [gold]Strength[/gold].
YUWANCARD-GLUTTONOUS_PIG.flavor: The gluttonous pig devours all rewards.
YUWANCARD-PIG_STAND_CHICKEN.title: Pig Stand Chicken
YUWANCARD-PIG_STAND_CHICKEN.description: At the start of your turn, deal [blue]3[/blue] damage to a random enemy. If you played at least [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Attack[/gold] cards last turn, deal [blue]8[/blue] damage instead.
YUWANCARD-PIG_STAND_CHICKEN.flavor: Stand firm enough, and the peck hits harder.
YUWANCARD-HONG_MENG_PIG.title: Hong Meng Pig
YUWANCARD-HONG_MENG_PIG.description: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold], [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold], and [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Ritual[/gold].
YUWANCARD-HONG_MENG_PIG.flavor: When chaos first opened, the first oink was already there.
YUWANCARD-TANK_PIG.title: Tank Pig
YUWANCARD-TANK_PIG.description: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]6[/blue] [gold]Plating[/gold]. Whenever you gain [gold]Block[/gold], deal [blue]2[/blue] damage to a random enemy.
YUWANCARD-TANK_PIG.flavor: When the armor is thick enough, everything becomes a battering ram.
YUWANCARD-TRAP_PIG.title: Trap Pig
YUWANCARD-TRAP_PIG.description: At the end of your turn, apply [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Poison[/gold] and [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Weak[/gold] to a random enemy. If that enemy attacked you this turn, apply [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Poison[/gold] and [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Weak[/gold] instead.
YUWANCARD-TRAP_PIG.flavor: Before the trap springs, nobody knows what is hiding in the grass.
YUWANCARD-CRYSTAL_PIG.title: Crystal Pig
YUWANCARD-CRYSTAL_PIG.description: Whenever you gain Energy, including at the start of your turn, deal [blue]2[/blue] damage to a random enemy and gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
YUWANCARD-CRYSTAL_PIG.flavor: Every spark of energy refracts into a flash of force.
YUWANCARD-GLUTTONS_FEAST_RUNE.title: Glutton's Feast
YUWANCARD-GLUTTONS_FEAST_RUNE.descriptio: At the start of combat, add 1 random [gold]FoodPig[/gold] card to your hand.
YUWANCARD-GLUTTONS_FEAST_RUNE.flavor: Serve the meal before the brawl.
YUWANCARD-HEXTECH_RUNE_RARITY.label: [color=#FF00FF]Piggy Hextech[/color]
YUWANCARD-SIN_OF_GLUTTONY_RUNE.title: Sin of Gluttony
YUWANCARD-SIN_OF_GLUTTONY_RUNE.descripti:
Whenever you [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a card, gain {StrengthPower} [gold]Strength[/gold].
Whenever you play a [gold]FoodPig[/gold] card, gain {DexterityPower} [gold]Dexterity[/gold]. Each effect triggers up to {TriggerLimit} times per turn.
YUWANCARD-SIN_OF_GLUTTONY_RUNE.flavor: The more you eat, the more you crave.
YUWANCARD-SIN_OF_GREED_RUNE.title: Sin of Greed
YUWANCARD-SIN_OF_GREED_RUNE.description:
At the start of combat, gain {StrengthPower} [gold]Strength[/gold] for every {GoldThreshold} Gold you have, up to {StrengthCap}.
Whenever you gain Gold, deal {Damage} damage to a random enemy.
YUWANCARD-SIN_OF_WRATH_RUNE.title: Sin of Wrath
YUWANCARD-SIN_OF_WRATH_RUNE.description:
Whenever you take unblocked attack damage, gain {StrengthPower} [gold]Strength[/gold] and {GuardAmount} [gold]temporary HP[/gold].
Your Attack cards deal [blue]{AttackBonusPercent}%[/blue] more damage.
YUWANCARD-SIN_OF_WRATH_RUNE.flavor: Wounds never quench reason; they only stoke the rage.
YUWANCARD-SIN_OF_SLOTH_RUNE.title: Sin of Sloth
YUWANCARD-SIN_OF_SLOTH_RUNE.description: At end of turn, if you played no more than {CardThreshold} cards this turn, gain {StrengthPower} [gold]Strength[/gold] and {PlatingPower} [gold]Plating[/gold].
YUWANCARD-SIN_OF_PRIDE_RUNE.title: Sin of Pride
YUWANCARD-SIN_OF_PRIDE_RUNE.description:
If your HP is above 80%, gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} at the start of your turn. Whenever you kill an enemy, gain {StrengthPower} [gold]Strength[/gold].
If you take damage, lose all Strength granted by this rune.
YUWANCARD-SIN_OF_ENVY_RUNE.title: Sin of Envy
YUWANCARD-SIN_OF_ENVY_RUNE.description:
Whenever an enemy gains a Buff, you have a 50% chance to gain 1 stack of that Buff as well.
Each enemy can trigger this at most 2 times per turn.
YUWANCARD-SIN_OF_ENVY_RUNE.flavor: What you have, I must have too.
YUWANCARD-SIN_OF_LUST_RUNE.title: Sin of Lust
YUWANCARD-SIN_OF_LUST_RUNE.description:
The first Debuff you apply each turn is also applied to all other enemies.
Whenever you apply {DebuffThreshold} Debuffs to enemies, gain 1 [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
YUWANCARD-SIN_OF_LUST_RUNE.flavor: Love is for sharing, and so is pain.
YUWANCARD-PIGLET_DASH_RUNE.title: Piglet Dash
YUWANCARD-PIGLET_DASH_RUNE.description: Whenever you play a [gold]FoodPig[/gold] card, gain {Block} [gold]Block[/gold].
YUWANCARD-PIGLET_DASH_RUNE.flavor: Even carrying a food bowl, it sprints like the wind.
YUWANCARD-SAVINGS_ACCOUNT_RUNE.title: Piggy Bank
YUWANCARD-SAVINGS_ACCOUNT_RUNE.descripti: Whenever you gain Gold, gain 1 temporary [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn with a 50% chance.
YUWANCARD-SAVINGS_ACCOUNT_RUNE.flavor: The richer you get, the more it goes to your head.
YUWANCARD-HEARTY_MEAL_RUNE.title: Hearty Meal
YUWANCARD-HEARTY_MEAL_RUNE.description: Whenever you [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a card, heal 1 HP.
YUWANCARD-HEARTY_MEAL_RUNE.flavor: Eat your fill, then get hungry again.
YUWANCARD-PIGLET_GUARD_RUNE.title: Piglet Guard
YUWANCARD-PIGLET_GUARD_RUNE.description:
Your pig minion gains {PlatingPower} [gold]Plating[/gold].
At the start of your turn, if you have a pig minion, gain {Block} [gold]Block[/gold].
YUWANCARD-PIGLET_GUARD_RUNE.flavor: One watches the front, one watches the back.
YUWANCARD-TOUGH_PIGSKIN_RUNE.title: Tough Pigskin
YUWANCARD-TOUGH_PIGSKIN_RUNE.description:
Whenever you gain [gold]Block[/gold], gain 1 extra [gold]Plating[/gold].
Triggers up to {TriggerLimit} times each combat.
YUWANCARD-PIGLET_RECHARGE_RUNE.title: Piglet Recharge
YUWANCARD-PIGLET_RECHARGE_RUNE.descripti: Whenever you play {AttackThreshold} Attack cards, gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
YUWANCARD-PIGLET_RECHARGE_RUNE.flavor: Fight long enough and the charge kicks in.
YUWANCARD-SHARE_THE_FOOD_RUNE.title: Share the Food
YUWANCARD-SHARE_THE_FOOD_RUNE.descriptio: Whenever you play a [gold]FoodPig[/gold] card, all teammates gain 1 temporary [gold]Strength[/gold].
YUWANCARD-SHARE_THE_FOOD_RUNE.flavor: Not one bite gets left off your plate.
YUWANCARD-PIG_BREEDER_RUNE.title: Pig Breeder
YUWANCARD-PIG_BREEDER_RUNE.description: Whenever you summon a pig minion, trigger one extra upgrade.
YUWANCARD-ENDLESS_BUFFET_RUNE.title: Endless Buffet
YUWANCARD-ENDLESS_BUFFET_RUNE.descriptio: Your [gold]FoodPig[/gold] cards have a 50% chance to return to your hand after being played.
YUWANCARD-ENDLESS_BUFFET_RUNE.flavor: Can't finish it. You just can't.
YUWANCARD-GILDED_PIGSKIN_RUNE.title: Gilded Pigskin
YUWANCARD-GILDED_PIGSKIN_RUNE.descriptio: At the start of your turn, for every {PlatingThreshold} [gold]Plating[/gold], gain 1 [gold]Strength[/gold].
YUWANCARD-GILDED_PIGSKIN_RUNE.flavor: Gold grows on the armor, strength grows on the gold.
YUWANCARD-COIN_RAIN_RUNE.title: Coin Rain
YUWANCARD-COIN_RAIN_RUNE.description: Whenever you gain Gold, deal {Damage} damage to all enemies.
YUWANCARD-COIN_RAIN_RUNE.flavor: Gold isn't for spending, it's for throwing.
YUWANCARD-SWORN_BROTHER_RUNE.title: Sworn Brother
YUWANCARD-SWORN_BROTHER_RUNE.description: Whenever your pig minion dies, gain {StrengthPower} [gold]Strength[/gold] and {DexterityPower} [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
YUWANCARD-SWORN_BROTHER_RUNE.flavor: Everything it took for you comes back around.
YUWANCARD-ANGEL_PIGLET_RUNE.title: Angel Piglet
YUWANCARD-ANGEL_PIGLET_RUNE.description: At the start of combat, gain 1 [gold]Angel Pig[/gold]. After your revival triggers, gain 1 [gold]Intangible[/gold].
YUWANCARD-ANGEL_PIGLET_RUNE.flavor: A second life should shine, too.
YUWANCARD-THRONE_OF_PIGS_RUNE.title: Throne of Pigs
YUWANCARD-THRONE_OF_PIGS_RUNE.descriptio: Whenever you gain [gold]Strength[/gold], your pig minions gain the same amount of [gold]Strength[/gold].
YUWANCARD-THRONE_OF_PIGS_RUNE.flavor: A throne carried by every little pig.
YUWANCARD-HEXTECH_SHOPPING_CART_RUNE.des: Requires [gold]Shopping Cart[/gold]. Items placed in the cart cost [blue]{DiscountPercent}%[/blue] less.
YUWANCARD-HEXTECH_SHOPPING_CART_RUNE.fla: This time it's really worth the buy.
YUWANCARD-PERPETUAL_PIG_RUNE.title: Perpetual Pig
YUWANCARD-PERPETUAL_PIG_RUNE.description: Your [gold]Pig Vampirism[/gold] and [gold]Pig Coin[/gold] no longer naturally lose stacks.
YUWANCARD-PERPETUAL_PIG_RUNE.flavor: Once it starts spinning, it never stops.
YUWANCARD-PIGLET_COLLAR_FORGE.title: Piglet Collar
YUWANCARD-PIGLET_COLLAR_FORGE.descriptio: At the start of combat, gain 1 [gold]Pig Friends[/gold].
YUWANCARD-PIGLET_COLLAR_FORGE.flavor: Put it on, and home gets a lot livelier.
YUWANCARD-LUSTFUL_PIG.title: Lustful Pig
YUWANCARD-LUSTFUL_PIG.description: At the start of each combat, all enemies gain 2 [gold]Weak[/gold]. Enemies have a [blue]40%[/blue] chance to attack themselves.
YUWANCARD-LUSTFUL_PIG.flavor: The lustful pig, lost in chaotic desire.
YUWANCARD-PIG_CARROT.title: Carrot
YUWANCARD-PIG_CARROT.description: At the start of each combat, gain {PlatingPower:diff()} [gold]Plating[/gold].
YUWANCARD-PIG_GOLDEN_CARROT.title: Golden Carrot
YUWANCARD-PIG_GOLDEN_CARROT.description: At the start of each combat, gain {PlatingPower:diff()} [gold]Plating[/gold].
YUWANCARD-PIG_GOLDEN_CARROT.flavor: A legendary golden carrot with mysterious power.
YUWANCARD-PIG_ROAST_PORK.title: Roast Pork
YUWANCARD-PIG_ROAST_PORK.description: Can choose the Roast Pork option at [gold]Rest Sites[/gold].
YUWANCARD-TEAMMATE_PAY.title: Teammate Pay
YUWANCARD-TEAMMATE_PAY.description: In the shop, you can ask teammates to buy items for you. After they agree, the gold is deducted from their account and the item belongs to you. [blue]As long as one team member has this relic, all teammates can use the pay feature.[/blue]
YUWANCARD-TEAMMATE_PAY.flavor: Share the fortune, share the burden.
YUWANCARD-SHOPPING_CART.title: Shopping Cart
YUWANCARD-SHOPPING_CART.description: Add items to your cart in the shop and buy them later. The cart can hold up to {Capacity} items.
YUWANCARD-TRANSFORM_TABLE.title: Transform Table
YUWANCARD-TRANSFORM_TABLE.description:
Each combat, you may right-click this relic to convert 1 card in your hand's current energy cost into that much energy, then remove that card from combat.
This can trigger up to [blue]5[/blue] times each combat. [blue]0[/blue]-cost cards and X-cost cards cannot be selected.
YUWANCARD-TRANSFORM_TABLE.selectionPromp: Choose 1 hand card to convert its cost into energy and remove it from combat
YUWANCARD-HEARTSTEEL.title: Heartsteel
YUWANCARD-HEARTSTEEL.description:
When you deal more than {Threshold} damage to the same enemy in a single turn, trigger "[gold]Colossal Appetite[/gold]" on that enemy (once per enemy per combat).
[gold]Colossal Appetite[/gold]: This attack deals bonus damage equal to [blue]10%[/blue] of your current HP, and permanently increases your max HP by [green]{MaxHpGain}[/green].
YUWANCARD-HEARTSTEEL.flavor: Where the heart leads, steel follows.
YUWANCARD-ALL_I_WANT.title: All I Want
YUWANCARD-ALL_I_WANT.description: You may choose any number of cards from [gold]card rewards[/gold].
YUWANCARD-ALL_I_WANT.flavor: Adults do not choose just one.
YUWANCARD-WHITE_SCARF.title: White Scarf
YUWANCARD-WHITE_SCARF.description: After combat victory, gain an additional [gold]Colorless card[/gold] reward.
YUWANCARD-WHITE_SCARF.flavor: A warm scarf that brings unexpected surprises.
YUWANCARD-SKULL_GOLD.title: Skull Gold
YUWANCARD-SKULL_GOLD.description: After each combat, gain an additional [gold]{GoldAmount}[/gold] Gold.
YUWANCARD-SKULL_GOLD.flavor: Doo doo da doo doo da.
YUWANCARD-TRIPLE_PLAY.description: When you play the 3rd card of the same type in a row in a turn, play the 3rd card an additional time.
YUWANCARD-BLACK_FLASH.title: Black Flash
YUWANCARD-BLACK_FLASH.description: When you play a card with "Strike" in its name, there is a 10% chance to deal 2.5x damage.
YUWANCARD-BLACK_FLASH.flavor: In that fleeting flash, death strikes.
YUWANCARD-PIG_RUSH_FORWARD.title: Pig Rush Forward
YUWANCARD-PIG_RUSH_FORWARD.description: When you deal damage to an enemy, reduce that enemy's max HP by the damage dealt.
YUWANCARD-PIG_DEMON_FORM.title: Demon Form
YUWANCARD-PIG_DEMON_FORM.description: At the start of your turn, gain {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
YUWANCARD-SMALL_DECK.title: Small Deck
YUWANCARD-SMALL_DECK.description: When obtained, remove up to 5 cards from your [gold]deck[/gold].
YUWANCARD-SMALL_DECK.flavor: "If you play small deck again, I'll find someone to deal with you."
YUWANCARD-YANG_SWORD_GOURD.title: Sword-Nurturing Gourd
YUWANCARD-YANG_SWORD_GOURD.description: At the start of your turn, gain [blue]{Forge}[/blue] [gold]Forge[/gold].
YUWANCARD-YANG_SWORD_GOURD.flavor: Sword intent stored long, drawn to stunning effect.
YUWANCARD-THOUSAND_CURSE_SCROLL.title: Thousand Curse Scroll
YUWANCARD-THOUSAND_CURSE_SCROLL.descript: Whenever you gain a [gold]Curse[/gold] card, [gold]Exhaust[/gold] it, then gain 1 [gold]Strength[/gold] and 1 [gold]Dexterity[/gold]. Each combat, you can gain up to 5 [gold]Strength[/gold] and 5 [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
YUWANCARD-THOUSAND_CURSE_SCROLL.flavor: Only one who has borne the seven curses can wield this.
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_ENTRY.title: What If Only...
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_ENTRY.description: Choose a relic that changes the rules of the run.
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_SKIP.title: Skip
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_RARITY.label: What If Relic
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_JACKPOT.title: What If Only Jackpot
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_JACKPOT.description:
When obtained, transform all cards in your deck into [gold]Jackpot[/gold].
Card rewards contain only [gold]Jackpot[/gold].
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_TRIPLE_PLAY.title: What If Only 33
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_TRIPLE_PLAY.descriptio: Relic drops and treasure chest relics become 33 only.
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_SERIES_RELICS.title: What If Only Seven Sin Pigs
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_SERIES_RELICS.descript: Relic drops and treasure chest relics become Seven Sin Pig series relics only.
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_QUESTION_MARK.title: What If Only Unknown Rooms
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_QUESTION_MARK.descript:
All rooms on the map become unknown rooms.
Except for Ancient, Rest Site, and Boss rooms.
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_BIG_BANG.title: What If Only Big Bang
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_BIG_BANG.description:
When obtained, transform all cards in your deck into [gold]Big Bang[/gold].
Card rewards contain only [gold]Big Bang[/gold].
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_WHISTLE.title: What If Only Whistle
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_WHISTLE.description:
When obtained, transform all cards in your deck into [gold]Whistle[/gold].
Card rewards contain only [gold]Whistle[/gold].
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_STRIKE.title: What If Only Strike
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_STRIKE.description:
When obtained, transform all cards in your deck: the first becomes [gold]Hellraiser[/gold], the rest become random [gold]Strike[/gold] cards.
Card rewards contain only cards with the [gold]Strike[/gold] tag.
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_DISCOVERY.title: What If Only: Discovery
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_DISCOVERY.description:
When obtained, transform all cards in your deck into [gold]Discovery[/gold].
Card rewards contain only [gold]Discovery[/gold].
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_DIRECT_FLIGHT.title: What If I Just Fly
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_DIRECT_FLIGHT.descript: When obtained, enables travel mode, allowing you to freely select any room on the map.
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_HEARTSTEEL.title: What If Only Heartsteel
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_HEARTSTEEL.description: Relic drops and treasure chest relics become [gold]Heartsteel[/gold] only.
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_OLD_COIN.title: What If Only Old Coin
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_OLD_COIN.description: Relic drops and treasure chest relics become [gold]Old Coin[/gold] only.
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_OLD_COIN.flavor: Money isn't everything, but having none gets you nowhere.
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_WHITE_STAR.title: What If Only White Star
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_WHITE_STAR.description: Relic drops and treasure chest relics become [gold]White Star[/gold] only.
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_WHITE_STAR.flavor: Amid countless stars, only this one.
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_DRAGON_FRUIT.title: What If Only Dragon Fruit
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_DRAGON_FRUIT.descripti: Relic drops and treasure chest relics become [gold]Dragon Fruit[/gold] only.
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_HISTORY_COURSE.title: What If Only History Course
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_HISTORY_COURSE.descrip: Relic drops and treasure chest relics become [gold]History Course[/gold] only.
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_HISTORY_COURSE.flavor: Study the past, and you'll know the rise and fall.
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_CHEMICAL_X.title: What If Only Chemical X
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_CHEMICAL_X.description: Relic drops and treasure chest relics become [gold]Chemical X[/gold] only.
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_BING_BONG.title: What If Only Bing Bong
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_BING_BONG.description: Relic drops and treasure chest relics become [gold]Bing Bong[/gold] only.
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_ALL_CARDS_ARE_IRON_WAV: What If Every Card Is Iron Wave
Whenever you play a card, gain {Block} [gold]Block[/gold] and deal {Damage} damage to a random enemy.
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_I_AM_SNAKEBITE.title: What If I Am Snakebite
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_I_AM_SNAKEBITE.descrip: At the start of your turn, apply {PoisonPower:diff()} [gold]Poison[/gold] to a random enemy.
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_ANGRY.title: What If Angry
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_ANGRY.description: At the end of your turn, add 1 [gold]Anger[/gold] to your discard pile.
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_ONLY_RARE.title: What If I Could Only Get Rare Cards
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_ONLY_RARE.description:
When obtained, transform every card in your deck into a random [gold]Rare[/gold] card.
Card rewards only offer [gold]Rare[/gold] cards.
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_ONLY_UNCOMMON.title: What If I Could Only Get Uncommon Cards
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_ONLY_UNCOMMON.descript:
When obtained, transform every card in your deck into a random [gold]Uncommon[/gold] card.
Card rewards only offer [gold]Uncommon[/gold] cards.
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_ONLY_COMMON.title: What If I Could Only Get Common Cards
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_ONLY_COMMON.descriptio:
When obtained, transform every card in your deck into a random [gold]Common[/gold] card.
Card rewards only offer [gold]Common[/gold] cards.
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_ONLY_ATTACK.title: What If I Could Only Get Attack Cards
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_ONLY_ATTACK.descriptio:
When obtained, transform every card in your deck into a random [gold]Attack[/gold] card.
Card rewards only offer [gold]Attack[/gold] cards.
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_ONLY_ATTACK.flavor: The best defense is a good offense.
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_ONLY_SKILL.title: What If I Could Only Get Skill Cards
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_ONLY_SKILL.description:
When obtained, transform every card in your deck into a random [gold]Skill[/gold] card.
Card rewards only offer [gold]Skill[/gold] cards.
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_ONLY_POWER.title: What If I Could Only Get Power Cards
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_ONLY_POWER.description:
When obtained, transform every card in your deck into a random [gold]Power[/gold] card.
Card rewards only offer [gold]Power[/gold] cards.
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_ONLY_COLORLESS.title: What If I Could Only Get Colorless Cards
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_ONLY_COLORLESS.descrip:
When obtained, transform every card in your deck into a random [gold]Colorless[/gold] card.
Card rewards only offer [gold]Colorless[/gold] cards.
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_SNAKEBITE.title: What If Only Snakebite
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_SNAKEBITE.description:
When obtained, transform all cards in your deck into [gold]Snakebite[/gold].
Card rewards contain only [gold]Snakebite[/gold].
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_DIRECT_WIN.title: What If I Just Win
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_DIRECT_WIN.description: When obtained, reduce your HP to [blue]10%[/blue] of max HP and add a [gold]Underdog's Triumph[/gold] to your deck.
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_TEN_YEAR_BAMBOO.title: What If Only Ten Year Bamboo
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_TEN_YEAR_BAMBOO.descri: Relic drops and treasure chest relics become [gold]Ten Year Bamboo[/gold] only.
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_TEN_YEAR_BAMBOO.flavor: Get ten Ten Year Bamboos and ascend straight to godhood.
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_ANCIENT_CARDS.title: What If Only Ancient Cards
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_ANCIENT_CARDS.descript:
When obtained, remove the Basic cards from your deck and add all Ancient cards to it.
Card rewards contain only Ancient cards.
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_DRAMATIC_ENTRANCE.desc:
When obtained, transform all cards in your deck into [gold]Dramatic Entrance[/gold].
Card rewards contain only [gold]Dramatic Entrance[/gold].
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_MONSTER_ELITE.title: What If All Monsters Become Elites
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_MONSTER_ELITE.descript: Turn all normal enemy rooms into Elite rooms.
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_MONSTER_ELITE.flavor: We're here to fight the elites!
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_ALL_RELICS.title: What If I Had Every Relic
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_ALL_RELICS.description: When obtained, directly gain every in-game relic you do not already own, excluding relics that take effect immediately on pickup or interfere with rewards.
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_ALL_FORMS.title: What If I Had All Forms
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_ALL_FORMS.description: When obtained, add all Form cards to your [gold]deck[/gold].
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_ALL_FORMS.flavor:
If I had all forms,
If I had all form.
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_THREE_EGGS.title: What If I Had 3 Eggs
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_THREE_EGGS.description: When obtained, gain [gold]Frozen Egg[/gold], [gold]Toxic Egg[/gold], and [gold]Molten Egg[/gold].
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_FORGE_PERSISTS.title: What If Forge Persists Forever
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_FORGE_PERSISTS.descrip: After combat, your current [gold]Forge[/gold] is not cleared and is restored at the start of the next combat.
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_FORGE_PERSISTS.flavor: Forged a hundred times, never melted down.
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_SHA.title: What If Only Kill
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_SHA.description:
When obtained, transform all cards in your deck into [gold]Kill[/gold].
Card rewards contain only [gold]Kill[/gold].
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_DOUBLE_MAP_LENGTH.desc: Doubles the map length of each act.
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_DOUBLE_MAP_LENGTH.flav: Long and winding is the road ahead.
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_ELITE_BEFORE_REST.titl: What If There's Always an Elite Before Rest
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_ELITE_BEFORE_REST.desc: Every room directly before a [gold]Rest Site[/gold] becomes an [gold]Elite[/gold] room.
YUWANCARD-MALICE_RARITY.label: Malice Relic
YUWANCARD-ENVY_MALICE.title: Malice of Envy
YUWANCARD-ENVY_MALICE.description: If you killed any trait enemy this combat, gain an extra card reward.
YUWANCARD-ENVY_MALICE.flavor: If they get traits, you should get an extra share too.
YUWANCARD-GREED_MALICE.title: Malice of Greed
YUWANCARD-GREED_MALICE.description: If you killed any trait enemy this combat, gain extra gold.
YUWANCARD-WRATH_MALICE.title: Malice of Wrath
YUWANCARD-WRATH_MALICE.description: Deal 75% more damage to trait enemies.
YUWANCARD-WRATH_MALICE.flavor: Save the fury for the enemies who deserve it most.
YUWANCARD-PRIDE_MALICE.title: Malice of Pride
YUWANCARD-PRIDE_MALICE.description: Whenever your damage reduces an enemy's HP, gain 1 Strength.
YUWANCARD-PRIDE_MALICE.flavor: The more you kill, the more invincible you feel.
YUWANCARD-SLOTH_MALICE.title: Malice of Sloth
YUWANCARD-SLOTH_MALICE.description: Whenever your damage reduces an enemy's HP, gain 3 Block.
YUWANCARD-GLUTTONY_MALICE.title: Malice of Gluttony
YUWANCARD-GLUTTONY_MALICE.description: Whenever you kill a trait enemy, heal 10 HP.
YUWANCARD-GLUTTONY_MALICE.flavor: Even malice can be swallowed down.
YUWANCARD-LUST_MALICE.title: Malice of Lust
YUWANCARD-LUST_MALICE.description: If you killed any trait enemy this combat, gain a 40% chance for an extra relic.
YUWANCARD-LUST_MALICE.flavor: It always feels like there's room for a little more.
YUWANCARD-RECYCLE_BIN.title: Recycle Bin
YUWANCARD-RECYCLE_BIN.description:
When you skip cards, potions, or relics in rewards, store gold equal to 30% of their shop value.
Gain the stored gold when you enter a non-combat room.
YUWANCARD-RECYCLE_BIN.flavor: Toss it in first, cash out later.
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_INFINITE_UPGRADES.titl: What If I Could Upgrade Forever
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_INFINITE_UPGRADES.desc: All cards can be upgraded infinitely.
YUWANCARD-WHAT_IF_INFINITE_UPGRADES.flav: One more time, and one more time again.
YUWANCARD-BALATRO_RARITY.label: Balatro Relic
YUWANCARD-DICE.title: Dice
YUWANCARD-DICE.description: At the start of your turn, randomly set your Combo to 1 to 3, but never lower your current Combo.
YUWANCARD-DICE.flavor: With good luck, the hand is hot from the very first move.
YUWANCARD-CHIP.title: Chip
YUWANCARD-CHIP.description: At the start of combat, Combo +3.
YUWANCARD-CHIP.flavor: Put your opening bet on the table.
YUWANCARD-WILD_CARD.title: Wild Card
YUWANCARD-WILD_CARD.description: Status cards also count toward Combo, and Curse cards grant a larger Combo bonus.
YUWANCARD-STEEL_JOKER.title: Steel Joker
YUWANCARD-STEEL_JOKER.description: At end of turn, retain 20% of your Combo for next turn.
YUWANCARD-STEEL_JOKER.flavor: Hard enough for long enough, and the Combo won't break.
YUWANCARD-BLUEPRINT.title: Blueprint
YUWANCARD-BLUEPRINT.description: Your other Joker relic effects trigger an additional time.
YUWANCARD-BLUEPRINT.flavor: Copying the plan is a kind of skill too.
YUWANCARD-BLANK_VOUCHER.title: Blank Voucher
YUWANCARD-BLANK_VOUCHER.description: When obtained, choose 1 of 3 random Joker relics to gain.
YUWANCARD-BLANK_VOUCHER.flavor: Blank only means there is room for more.
YUWANCARD-LUCKY_CARD.title: Lucky Card
YUWANCARD-LUCKY_CARD.description: Every 7th card you play triggers 2 extra times.
YUWANCARD-GROWING_JOKER.title: Growing Joker
YUWANCARD-GROWING_JOKER.description: Whenever you add a modifier to a card, permanently gain 3 Max HP.
YUWANCARD-GROWING_JOKER.flavor: Every bit of crafting is a bit of growth.
YUWANCARD-GREED_JOKER.title: Greed Joker
YUWANCARD-GREED_JOKER.description: Every 3rd Attack card you play gives 5 Gold.
YUWANCARD-GREED_JOKER.flavor: When the fist comes down, the gold should ring out too.
YUWANCARD-GLUTTONY_JOKER.title: Gluttony Joker
YUWANCARD-GLUTTONY_JOKER.description: Every 4th Skill card you play heals 3 HP.
YUWANCARD-GLUTTONY_JOKER.flavor: Chain your skills and the HP bar fills right up.
YUWANCARD-MIRROR_JOKER.title: Mirror Joker
YUWANCARD-MIRROR_JOKER.description: If you play the same card type consecutively, the later card triggers 1 extra time.
YUWANCARD-MIRROR_JOKER.flavor: Whoever looks in the mirror always takes a second glance.
YUWANCARD-MISER_JOKER.title: Miser Joker
YUWANCARD-MISER_JOKER.description: Your Attack cards deal +1 damage for each 0-cost card in your hand.
YUWANCARD-MISER_JOKER.flavor: The less you're willing to spend, the more it hurts.
YUWANCARD-COLLECTOR_JOKER.title: Collector Joker
YUWANCARD-COLLECTOR_JOKER.description: At the start of your turn, gain 1 Energy for every 5 Rare or Ancient cards in your deck.
YUWANCARD-COLLECTOR_JOKER.flavor: The more you collect, the richer your opening.
YUWANCARD-GAMBLER_JOKER.title: Gambler Joker
YUWANCARD-GAMBLER_JOKER.description: When your Combo reaches 5 or higher, randomly deal 8 to 20 damage to an enemy.
YUWANCARD-GAMBLER_JOKER.flavor: Hand's hot, time to go all in.
YUWANCARD-POLYCHROME_JOKER.title: Polychrome Joker
YUWANCARD-POLYCHROME_JOKER.description: Whenever you play a card with a modifier, it triggers 1 extra time.
YUWANCARD-NEGATIVE_JOKER.title: Negative Joker
YUWANCARD-NEGATIVE_JOKER.description: Cards have a 30% chance to trigger 1 extra time when played.
YUWANCARD-NEGATIVE_JOKER.flavor: Flip to the negative side, and the action replays once more.
YUWANCARD-LEGEND_JOKER.title: Legend Joker
YUWANCARD-LEGEND_JOKER.description: This turn, each card you play grants an extra +0.2 Combo multiplier.
YUWANCARD-LEGEND_JOKER.flavor: A true legend turns every step into a climax.
YUWANCARD-HOLOGRAPHIC_JOKER.title: Holographic Joker
YUWANCARD-HOLOGRAPHIC_JOKER.description: At the start of your turn, add a copy of the first card you played last turn to your hand.
YUWANCARD-HOLOGRAPHIC_JOKER.flavor: Replaying the last hand is earning another.
YUWANCARD-BANKER_JOKER.title: Banker Joker
YUWANCARD-BANKER_JOKER.description: Whenever interest pays out, gain 3 extra Gold.
YUWANCARD-BANKER_JOKER.flavor: Making money make money, that's how it's done.
YUWANCARD-INVESTOR_JOKER.title: Investor Joker
YUWANCARD-INVESTOR_JOKER.description: After spending Gold in a shop, refund 20% of the amount spent.
YUWANCARD-INVESTOR_JOKER.flavor: This isn't spending. This is recycling cash flow.
YUWANCARD-MODIFIER_TOKEN.title: Modifier Token
YUWANCARD-MODIFIER_TOKEN.description: When obtained, store 1 Modifier Token. You can spend it at the Balatro Mod Station to buy a modifier for 1 card for free.
YUWANCARD-MODIFIER_TOKEN.flavor: This chip never reaches the table; it goes straight to the workshop.
YUWANCARD-SOFT_WARMTH.title: Soft Warmth
YUWANCARD-SOFT_WARMTH.description: At the start of your next 5 combats, gain {DexterityPower} [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
YUWANCARD-SOFT_WARMTH.flavor: The warmth from the other side of the screen wraps softly around you.
YUWANCARD-GOOD_ENCOUNTER.title: Pleasant Encounter
YUWANCARD-GOOD_ENCOUNTER.description: At the start of your next 5 combats, gain {StrengthPower} [gold]Strength[/gold].
YUWANCARD-GOOD_ENCOUNTER.flavor: Some encounters are brief, yet enough to carry you further.
YUWANCARD-PIGGY_DOLL.title: Piggy Doll
YUWANCARD-PIGGY_DOLL.description:
The first time you take damage each turn, reduce it by {DamageReduction}.
At the end of your turn, heal {Heal} HP.
YUWANCARD-PIGGY_DOLL.flavor: Soft and squishy. Poke it and it boops right back.
